newsitem.title: USA: FPIC Insurance says pursuing acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: FPIC Insurance says pursuing acquisitions.

text.p: FPIC Insurance Group Inc said Tuesday it is actively pursuing acquisition opportunities both within and outside of Florida.
The company did not provide further details. It said it remained focused on profitable growth in its core business.
The company said the APS Insurance Services acquisition was completed on July 1.
The company reported earnings per share for the second quarter of $0.42 compared with $0.47 per share, not including dilution from the recent public offering.

The company said revenues for the quarter increased 22 percent from $18.5 million to $22.6 million, primarily due to increases in the total number of insureds and the inclusion of revenues from recent acquisitions.

Revenue growth by sector showed a 17 percent increase in net premiums earned, an eight percent increase in net investment income, and a 114 percent increase in claims administration fee revenue due to the acquisition of Employers Mutual Inc on January 17.
